file.description: The collected file to read or search (from mode list). With search and no file, every collected file of the device is searched.

pattern.description: search: the pattern to look for.

context.description: search: lines of context around each match (at most 5).

start_line.description: read: the first line to return (default 1).

max_lines.description: read: lines to return (default 150, at most 500).

max_matches.description: search: matches to return (default 10, at most 50); page further with offset.

no_redact.description: Turn off the best-effort redaction of secret values after password, secret, community and key.

offset.description: search: skip this many matches first, to page past max_matches (50 at most per call); the limits give the next offset
